data.text:
Afsar vs State Of U P And Another on 18 November, 2024 
Bench: Anjani Kumar Mishra, Jayant Banerji
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:179988-Db
Court No. - 3
Case :- Writ - C No. - 37828 of 2024
Petitioner :- Afsar
Respondent :- State Of U P And Another
Counsel for Petitioner :- Akhilesh Kumar Pandey 
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.,Saurabh Tiwari
Hon'ble Anjani Kumar Mishra,J.
Hon'ble Jayant Banerji,J.
1.  Heard counsel for the petitioner and Shri Saurabh Tiwari, who appears for the Executive Engineer, Nagar Palika Parishad, Jalaun. 
2. It appears that the petitioner is seeking a direction for a decision on his representation dated 2.6.2023. The so-called representation in fact appears to be an application for grant of a license for sale of meat. 
3. It has been submitted by counsel for the respondent no. 2 that the Nagar Palika Parishad only has right to issue a 'no objection certificate'. The license itself is to be granted under the Food Safety Standards Act, 2006 by the competent authority therein. 
Afsar vs State Of U P And Another on 18 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/17232374/
1 4. On a query by the Court, it is admitted that no decision as regards grant of 'no objection certificate' which alone the Nagar Palika Parishad can grant has taken till date. 
5. Under the circumstances, this writ petition is disposed of directing the respondent no. 2 to consider the application of the petitioner and to take a call as to whether the 'no objection certificate'
which has to be granted by the respondent no. 2 is liable to be granted or not. It is expected that the decision shall be taken within two weeks from the date a certified copy of this order is filed before the respondent no. 2. 
Order Date :- 18.11.2024 A. V. Singh  Afsar vs State Of U P And Another on 18 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/17232374/
2
